messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Elevated 5xx rate detected in gateway-west. 5m error% 7% (SLO 0.5%). Route /v1/generate. Correlation prefix corr=wdg-7f2a. Paging oncall.

sara: I'm taking this. grabbing traces + kv logs now. @mike can you look at egress/retry patterns?

mike: oncall here — looking. can you paste a couple sample request lines?

sara: sample entries below (from kvlog bundle):
```
req_id=01f3a9c, corr=wdg-7f2a, route=/v1/generate, upstream=transformer-1, backend_status=504, backend_lat_ms=1203
req_id=01f3b2d, corr=wdg-7f2a, route=/v1/generate, upstream=transformer-1, backend_status=504, backend_lat_ms=1109
req_id=01f3d00, corr=wdg-7f2b, route=/v1/generate, upstream=transformer-2, backend_status=200, backend_lat_ms=95
```

raj: quick hypothesis: transformer-1 returning intermittent 504s under load; our retry ladder (max_retries=6 in west) seems higher than east (3) — possible retry amplification causing thundering herd.

elena: creating a log dropbox for collected artifacts, paste KV/traces there: https://logs.internal.redwood/dropbox/incident-2891012345 (use SSO)

sara: uploaded kvlogs + trace bundle to dropbox link above. included full header dump for a few samples.

mike: running a quick mitigation: enabling fallback policy on gateway-west to route to transformer-2 for /v1/generate, timeout 800ms, backoff short. Applying circuit-breaker decrease for transformer-1.

ops-bot: mitigation applied: fallback-policy(gateway-west) active, circuit-breaker transformer-1 tripped threshold lowered.

sara: customer-impact: ~12% of /v1/generate calls returned 5xx during peak window. Two enterprise customers reported errors: alpha-inc, beta-saas. Ops notified account reps.

raj: mapping corr ids in the dropbox shows many requests share a parent_cid -> hot path; also see repeated retries with same parent_cid within 2s windows.

mike: config check: west deploy shows HTTP_MAX_RETRIES=6, us-east=3. that's a config drift from the recent deployment. could explain amplification.

elena: noting deploy tags: west: deploy-2026-03-17-21a, env=prod-west. rolling diff created in config store.

sara: timeline so far:
- 12:02: alert fired (incident-bot)
- 12:03: sara ack + kvlog start
- 12:05: mitigation (fallback) applied by mike
- 12:07: kvlogs uploaded to dropbox
- 12:12: config diff found (max_retries mismatch)

mike: next actions: keep fallback active for 30m, throttle ingress to transformer-1 if we see retry amplification, collect upstream logs from transformer-1 owner, correlate by corr ids and req_ids, run query for burst of retries per parent_cid.

raj: taking lead for the next handoff window. I'll collect upstream logs and start the RCA doc. adding checklist to #incidents-runbook: gather kvlogs, upstream logs, deploy diffs, customer-impact table.

sara: handing to @raj for oncall handoff. I'll finish customer comms and attach error percentages per customer.

ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> degraded. Fallback policy holding error% down to ~1.8% at 12:20. Please continue collection & postmortem.

mike: note for RCA: search for header truncation or connection reset patterns in upstream logs; also verify retry-queue length and egress QPS during window.

raj: creating RCA doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/rca/incident-2891012345 (working draft). tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre.

sara: closing pager for now, will follow up with a detailed RCA + timeline. thanks team. :thumbsup:
